videos.title: Live WSL
videos.description: Manchester City v Tottenham Hotspur (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the Women's Super League match at JOIE Stadium. Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw scored the fastest hat-trick in WSL history in a 5-2 victory for City when these teams met here last season, with all three goals being headers scored in a 12-minute window early in the first half. It was also the fourth consecutive hat-trick for Shaw in home WSL matches against Spurs.
